office_does: Superior Court judges hear Cowlitz County's felony criminal cases, civil suits, family law, probate and juvenile matters; this seat is for a two-year unexpired term.
race_blurb: Judge Jill Karmy, appointed in 2025 and endorsed by the whole local Superior Court bench, faces career felony prosecutor Jacob Lervold, who runs on trial experience and a 'follow the law, not make it' philosophy.

candidates.summary: Superior Court judge since a September 2025 appointment, previously a court commissioner, civil litigator and municipal prosecutor.
highlights: Appointed by Governor Ferguson in 2025 after three years as a Superior Court commissioner [S4]
Former civil litigator and Battle Ground municipal prosecutor; co-created a therapeutic court [S2][S4]
Endorsed by all sitting Cowlitz County Superior Court judges [S1][S3]
Chosen for appointment by 87.7% of 65 respondents in a 2026 judicial evaluation poll published by her campaign [S5]

experience.basis: Sitting judge, recently appointed, with prior commissioner service and the full local bench's backing.

safety.basis: Mixed professional formation: civil litigation, municipal prosecution and co-creating a therapeutic diversion court.

candidates.summary: Senior Deputy Prosecuting Attorney in Cowlitz County whose whole legal career has been criminal prosecution, running on trial and appellate experience.
highlights: Says he has handled 450+ felony cases and 50+ trials, including homicides and child sex crimes [S2]
Assigned prosecutor for the Longview Street Crimes Unit and the Sheriff's Crime Reduction Team [S1][S2]
Philosophy: 'follow the law, not make it' and 'apply the law as written' [S2]
Endorsed by the Lewis, Thurston and Wahkiakum county prosecutors and Rep. Ed Orcutt [S2]

experience.basis: No judicial service; challenges a sitting appointed judge on courtroom experience.

judicial.basis: Campaign states a restraint philosophy: 'follow the law, not make it' and 'apply the law as written'.

safety.basis: Entire professional formation in prosecution, including drug-enforcement and crime-reduction team assignments.
